purpose: 256 px texture copies for phones: the Hollow Scavenger body's Photo metallic-roughness and normal maps, and the knife and cleaver maps. The player's own Photo maps and the hunter and boss knives already ship at 256; this brings the hollow body and the two hand props to the same size. Originals stay untouched; knife and cleaver are new files.
tool: art/phone-texture/cap_tex_roles.py src dst <role>=256 (Pillow LANCZOS, JPEG q90 4:4:4 optimize). Only image bufferView payloads change; every other byte range, including the EXT_meshopt_compression ranges, is copied byte-for-byte in original order. The script now reads the texture source through extensions (EXT_texture_webp) and copies meshopt-compressed ranges; before this change it could not process the hollow phone file.

hollow-scavenger-phone.changedImages: Photo metallicRoughness and normal, 512 -> 256. Colour maps (Photo, PhotoEyes, PhotoTeeth, 512) unchanged, so they stay shared with the player.

estimatedGpuMB.basis: RGBA8 with full mip chain (x4/3) per image

knife-phone.changedImages: colour 512 -> 256, metallicRoughness 512 -> 256, shaft colour 256x1024 -> 64x256 (the sizes the hunter knife uses).

verification.compare: every non-image byte range identical to the source (45 in the hollow body, 272 each in knife and cleaver); bufferView metadata and the rest of the glTF JSON identical apart from offsets.

pins: Only Web/public/assets/manifest-hollow.json changes: the hollow-scavenger row pin, the knife equipment urls now donor/knife-phone.glb, the cleaver equipment url and pin, and files rows weapon-phone and hollow-phone. donor/knife.glb, weapons/pitborn-cleaver.glb and their pins stay for every test and tool that reads the originals.
